name: B2 - Owner LinkedIn lookup
description: Apify people search for the Companies House director of each scored agency; URL and title saved to ops.agencies.

parameters.content:
## B2 - Owner LinkedIn lookup
For scored agencies with a director name from Companies House and no LinkedIn URL yet: one Apify harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search call per director ("Name Company", 3 results), keep the hit whose current company matches, save URL and title to ops.agencies. Paid: about $0.01 per lookup. Manual run, limit in Config.

nodeGroups.name: Find and save
nodeGroups.description: Candidates from Supabase, one Apify search per director, best match saved back
